frozen: 2026-10-29, before any calibration or test prediction was computed
owner_instruction: Yes to all (handoff/github-finds/PLAN_v2.md decision 1: run the certified-calls check on history)
question: Can LEARNER v2.4's model, fitted out of time, make calls whose losing rate is certified on one year (2022) by Learn then Test, and does the certificate hold on the next year (2023)?

events.what: the 6,225 US +30% spikes of 2020-2023 with LEARNER v2.4's 33 features and both labels; nothing from 2024 on

features: idxsig.learner3.FEATURES (the 33 of v2.4), standardised on each fit's rows
model: penalised logistic regression as in TA_HISTORY_v1 (precision 16 on slopes, 1/1.5^2 on the intercept; Newton with step-halving); nothing tuned

fits.note: the live procedure: certify on the latest resolved year with a model that has not seen it, then call the next year with a model refitted through the calibration year

DUMP.score: p, the predicted probability of the statement
DUMP.meaning: a call that the stock will dump; certified to be right at least half the time

SAFE.alpha: half the statement's base rate among the calibration fit's rows (2020-2021), computed from training labels only
SAFE.meaning: a call that the stock will not dump; certified to be wrong at most half as often as the base rate

thresholds: for each call, the calibration predictions' quantiles giving call shares 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50% (strictest first), fixed as score thresholds

certification.method: Learn then Test, fixed-sequence over the thresholds in the order above, exact binomial p-value for 'losing rate > alpha', delta 0.05, at least 10 calls to test (idxsig/risk_control.py)
certification.chosen: the certified threshold making the most calls on 2022, applied unchanged as a score threshold to the 2023 predictions

verdicts.BROKEN: the one-sided binomial p-value that the 2023 losing rate exceeds alpha is <= 0.0125 (0.05 over the four tests)

descriptive: the naive threshold (most calls with 2022 empirical losing rate <= alpha, no bound) and its 2023 losing rate
2023 calls as a share of events, base rates, the full 2022 test sequence
use: a certificate that HOLDS makes the method a candidate for a shadow report on LEARNER v2.4's live ledger (paper/CALL_CERT.md), recalibrated as outcomes resolve; v2.4's frozen calls are not changed either way
limitations: the binomial bound treats events as independent; spikes cluster in time, so the certificate is optimistic and 2023 is the honest check
one calibration year and one test year
2023 already chose v2.3's features in PATH_HISTORY_v1
